fuzzy_body.name: Two rooms claim one body
fuzzy_body.description: Move the black hand point. Inspect overlapping memberships on a sphere, blend lift/fold/twist rules, then select faces by an adjustable threshold. Original positions retained. Native Godot installation in the rear gallery of Shaders / Patterns.
interactions: Grab the black point and move left/right. Desktop can also use LEFT / CENTRE / RIGHT.
FIELDS shows degrees, RULES blends three transformations, CUT selects triangle centres by min(left,right).
Turn WIDTH, STRENGTH, THRESHOLD on the native console.
fuzzy_body.qfep_connection: Making degrees of membership visible exposes the authored field, aggregation rule and threshold. A softened boundary still depends on decisions; no claim that mathematical membership models social identity.
